svg.title: 02 | The frozen spread filter removed winners and reduced P&L
svg.desc: 3 completed trades removed; all 3 were profitable. Double-trigger P&L was unchanged at +$44.93 in both arms. Integrity passed; the frozen intervention was REJECTED without retuning. No confidence interval is inferred from these totals.
